name: talvio-email-service
install: corepack enable && corepack prepare yarn@4.3.1 --activate && yarn install --immutable && { [ -f .env ] || cp .env.example .env; }

terminals.name: serverless-offline
terminals.command: export SLS_DISABLE_AUTO_UPDATE=1; set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; if [ -n "${SERVERLESS_ACCESS_KEY:-}${SERVERLESS_LICENSE_KEY:-}" ]; then yarn start; else echo 'serverless-offline not started. Set the SERVERLESS_ACCESS_KEY (or SERVERLESS_LICENSE_KEY) secret to run the Serverless Framework v4 offline server on http://localhost:3000 (AWS credentials with SSM read access are also required to resolve serverless.ts variables). The dev inner loop (yarn lint / yarn typecheck / yarn test:coverage) works without these.'; fi
